description: Up to 40 busiest people over the last 7 days, ranked by percentile on three measures: how much they did, how many different things, and kinds of Kibana object. The selected person is an orange diamond; hover for raw numbers.

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) | WHERE user.email IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action), kinds = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.saved_object.type) BY key = user.email | SORT events DESC, key | LIMIT 40

FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) | STATS events = COUNT(*), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action) WHERE user.email IS NOT NULL, kinds = COUNT_DISTINCT(kibana.saved_object.type) WHERE user.email IS NOT NULL BY project = project.name, key = user.email | LIMIT 10000

SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?project == "" OR ?project == "Any") OR project.name == ?project) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND ENDS_WITH(?identity, " · Cloud API key") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND STARTS_WITH(?identity, "Unnamed key of ") AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any") OR client.ip == TO_IP(CASE((?client_ip == "" OR ?client_ip == "Any"), null, ?client_ip))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY project = project.name, key = user.email | LIMIT 10000

signals.name: scopeText
signals.update: nAll === 0 ? '' : nIn === 1 ? 'in ' + data('inScope')[0].project : whole ? 'across all ' + nAll + ' projects' : 'in ' + nIn + ' projects'

signals.name: headline
signals.update: empty ? ['No activity for this selection', 'in the last 7 days'] : nPeople === 0 ? ['No people with an email', (scopeText ? scopeText + ' · ' : '') + 'last 7 days'] : nPeople === 1 ? ['Only one person with an email' + sp + ' in 7 days', 'a rank needs two or more'] : ['Rank among ' + nPeople + ' people' + (approx ? ' · approximate' : ''), (scopeText ? scopeText + ' · ' : '') + 'last 7 days']

signals.name: basis
signals.update: whole ? (nAll > 1 ? 'all ' + nAll + ' projects (exact)' : nAll === 1 ? data('estateProjects')[0].project + ' (exact)' : 'all events (exact)') : nIn === 1 ? data('inScope')[0].project + ' (exact)' : nIn + ' projects (approximate: events summed, distinct counts are the largest per project)'

signals.name: emptyLead
signals.update: !noRank ? '' : empty ? 'No activity for this selection' : nPeople === 0 ? 'No people with an email' : 'Only one person with an email'

signals.name: emptyBody
signals.update: !noRank ? [] : empty ? ['in the last 7 days'] : nPeople === 0 ? [(scopeText ? scopeText + ' · ' : '') + 'last 7 days'] : [(scopeText ? scopeText + ' · ' : '') + 'last 7 days', 'a rank needs two or more', '', single.key, format(single.events, ',') + ' events', single.actions + ' distinct actions · ' + single.kinds + ' object kinds']

tooltip.signal: datum.highlight ? null : {'Identity': datum.key, 'Measure': datum.measure, 'Value': format(datum.value, ','), 'Percentile': format(datum.pct, '.0%'), 'Ranked within': basis}
datum.highlight ? {'Selected': datum.key, 'Measure': datum.measure, 'Value': format(datum.value, ','), 'Percentile': format(datum.pct, '.0%'), 'Ranked within': basis} : null
